findings.issue: 〜てほしい means the speaker wants SOMEONE ELSE to do the action, but lit_en renders it as the speaker's own action ('I want to boil'), which would be ゆでたい. Contradicts the item's own expl_en ('to want someone to do') and swaps the agent.
findings.current: I want to boil eggs (object), that's the thing (explanatory).
findings.suggested: I want (you) to boil the egg (object), that's the thing (explanatory).

findings.issue: Same agent problem as lit_en: 'cozinhar-e quero' reads as 'quero cozinhar' (speaker boils), but 〜てほしい = querer que OUTRA pessoa faça. The mirror should signal the other-agent desiderative.
findings.suggested: Ovo (objeto) cozinhar-e quero (que você faça) (explicativo) é.
